verdict.rationale: A SaaS expense platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents none. The Integration Server API credentials and OAuth flow are developer building blocks. The npm commands in the Expensify/App repo build the app itself and are not a user-facing CLI. The plain-language 'Ask Expensify' AI is an adjacent in-app feature, not a command-line tool.
